rules.applies_to: questions the page leaves undecided (no precedent, ruling, issue, engine-sure, semantic-decide)
rules.rule: engine probability max(p, 1-p) >= 0.8 AND semantic top-1 cosine >= 0.8 AND both give the same answer -> answer it
rules.source: E46 combo_search.py reference rule (14/14 on BT22-ST22 undecided, chosen among 1,793 rules: biased)
rules.test: BT25 (or the next set) official yes/no Q&A, evidence = all older products; success if accuracy >= 97% with n >= 10

rules.applies_to: questions the page leaves undecided (same definition as R1: tests/tdec.js with TDEC_NEW=BT25, decision by == null)
rules.rule: own model q15_v2 (adapter zip sha256 8C0894D6B363119A9078C7C9F215043CA7F577A19BCC11EFCE4605BC70FCE6BC, private repo digimon-judge-models adapters/q15_v2; Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, prompt layout 2, k 2, max_len 1024) gives max(P(yes), 1-P(yes)) >= 0.9873 at the first token -> answer yes if P(yes) >= 0.5 else no
rules.inputs: items from train/export_dataset.py with EXPORT_NEW=BT25 (neighbours from older products only); scored by train/prereg_r2.py
rules.source: threshold chosen on valid for a 98% target by train_gen.py; on BT22-ST22 held questions it added 20/294 at 20/20 (complement_eval.py) — measured after the threshold was fixed, but the training recipe (layout 2) was chosen after seeing q15_light results on the same test
rules.test: BT25 (or the next set) official yes/no Q&A held by the page; success if accuracy >= 97% with n >= 10; only then the page may show it as an automatic judgment

notes.about: R1 held definition, fixed before any official BT25 Q&A exist; rule text, thresholds and success criteria are unchanged
notes.note: R1 applies_to lists semantic-decide, but tests/tdec.js runs the distribution build, which has no semantic path. Official scoring of R1 and R2 uses tests/tdec.js decision by == null, as R2 already states. If a server-side semantic decision exists for a held item, a sensitivity result excluding those items is reported beside it; the tdec.js result stays the primary one.
